## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Maximum Credible Earthquake (MCE)"`

```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
# MCE products carry no TR and use their own fractile set: clear pins
# left in the global env by earlier slides before any child knits.
rm(list = intersect(c("TR.target", "p.target"), ls()))
ID.target <- sort(unique(MCETable[
  !ID %in% c("max", "min") & !grepl("\\.(site|max)$", ID),
  ID
]))
if (!exists("siteID.target") || !length(siteID.target)) {
  siteID.target <- sort(unique(MCETable[!is.na(siteID) & nzchar(siteID), siteID]))
}
Vs30.target <- 760
.IDS <- ID.target
.SITE <- if (length(siteID.target) == 1L) tolower(siteID.target) else NULL
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (.scn in .IDS) {
  cat("\n### ", .scn, "\n\n", sep = "")
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/MCE.UHS.qmd",
    stem = paste(c(.SITE, tolower(.scn), "mce-uhs"), collapse = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(ID.target = .scn, p.target = c("mean", "0.84", "0.90", "0.95"), Sa.log = TRUE),
    root = root
  )
}
rm(.scn)
cat("\n### PGA\n\n")
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_tbl/MCE.PGA.qmd",
  stem = paste(c(.SITE, "mce-pga"), collapse = "-"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(ID.target = .IDS, p.target = c("0.50", "0.84", "0.90", "0.95", "mean")),
  root = root
)
cat("\n### PSA\n\n")
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_tbl/MCE.PSA.qmd",
  stem = paste(c(.SITE, "mce-psa"), collapse = "-"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(ID.target = .IDS, p.target = c("0.50", "0.84", "0.90", "0.95", "mean")),
  root = root
)
```
